action: Update Firefox to version 160 (or later) on all managed desktops and confirm automatic updates are on; review Firefox ESR, Firefox for iOS and Thunderbird against Mozilla's advisories index.
exec: A very large batch of browser flaws, 57 rated high, means unpatched staff browsers are an easy way in.
plain: Mozilla fixed 99 security flaws in the Firefox browser, 57 of them rated high. Updating to Firefox 160 closes them.

key_findings: Mozilla Foundation Security Advisory 2026-125 was announced on November 10, 2026 with an overall impact of High.
It covers 99 CVEs: 57 High, 24 Moderate and 18 Low, fixed in Firefox 160.
The advisory page does not say whether any of the issues are exploited in the wild.
JPCERT/CC's weekly report of November 18 lists Firefox, Firefox ESR, Firefox for iOS and Thunderbird as affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
recommendations: Update Firefox to version 160 or later.
Check the Mozilla advisories index for the ESR, iOS and Thunderbird fixes.

summary: Mozilla's advisory MFSA 2026-125 of November 10 lists 99 CVEs fixed in Firefox 160: 57 rated High, 24 Moderate and 18 Low, with overall impact High. The page does not say any are exploited. JPCERT/CC's weekly report also flags Firefox ESR, Firefox for iOS and Thunderbird.
title: Mozilla fixes 99 Firefox vulnerabilities in Firefox 160 (MFSA 2026-125)

validation.note: Mozilla advisory read in full; JPCERT/CC weekly report read as second publisher (it points to the same advisory).
